authority: deduplication is record identity hygiene, not evidence adjudication

collision_rules.conflicting_metadata: retain conflicting values with provenance; never choose silently
collision_rules.same_normalized_doi: merge identity references, preserve every provider provenance record
collision_rules.same_provider_id: merge only inside the provider namespace, preserve cross-provider distinctions
collision_rules.same_title_author_year: candidate duplicate only; require manual review before merge
collision_rules.unresolved_collision: retain records separately and mark the collision unresolved

non_dedupe_claim: a deduplicated bibliographic identity is not a validated conclusion and does not upgrade evidence maturity

normalization.author: use first author only for the third-level collision key
normalization.doi: lowercase, trim URL/prefix punctuation, preserve the normalized DOI string
normalization.provider_id: retain provider namespace and exact stable identifier
normalization.title: Unicode normalize, lowercase, collapse whitespace and punctuation conservatively
normalization.year: use the declared publication year; do not manufacture a year
